description: Freight Australia sector, commodity and deep-dive reports (20 reports) is a group of 20 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts (DITRDCSA). Members: Cement Commodity Report; Cropping Sector Report; Fuel (refined) Commodity Report; Fuel Sector Report; General Goods (containerised household goods) Commodity Report; General Goods Sector Report; Grain (wheat) Commodity Report; Horticulture Sector Report; and 12 more. Example entry: This publication contains analyses of data related to performance of domestic and international cement supply chains. Focus is placed on understanding the risks associated with road and port freight activity, with key Australian freight metrics benchmarked against the United States (U.S.) and France. Data is available for download. Coverage is Australia and its states and territories, 2006 to 2021; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as infrequent, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-03-11. Files and pages listed: HTML, PDF, XLSX (22 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
